maddeler.e:
تعتطفوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَطِفُوا (taʕtaṭifū) /taʕ.ta.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# تُعْتَطَفُوا (tuʕtaṭafū) /tuʕ.ta.tˤa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
